turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting, and stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI or ask you to step out of it. Only the words END MEETING, typed on their own line, end the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have about twenty minutes, so let's start with why my son's mark is a zero.
I'm waiting. Who decided on the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?
I know your family has a history with academic integrity at this school. Claire's case.
You'll want to be very careful about the next sentence, Hale. Claire's case has nothing to do with Owen, and I'm sure the principal will want to hear that you raised it.
Maybe this runs in the family.

"Runs in the family." I'm writing that down, word for word. My son has never lied to me, and if you're calling either of my children a cheater, you'd better have a document in your hand.

I'm giving you one chance to answer my question. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen heard first?
